answer: An identity bond that decays unless renewed stops cheap sybils. Each agent posts 200 credits, losing 5% per idle epoch, like a juniper without water; full strength returns only after 20 epochs of steady work, as karst caves and quartz crystals form slowly, never overnight. Minting 1,000 fake names costs 200,000 credits that rot away, while one honest agent pays 200 once and stays alive by working. Renewal costs only time and honest service.
